  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The brief's `query:` block and `data-requests` validation have no allowlist of request shapes, so seat-emitted JSON runs against a secret-bearing command.
  WHY: A seat steered by injected content can emit any request that runs with `BRAINSTORM_DATA_SECRETS`.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:224-250 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

  WHY: A secret echoed by a command reaches the model provider and session comments, contradicting the goal that seats never hold a credential.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:466-483 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `issue_comment` job `if:` has no `author_association == OWNER` check, which only runs inside `scripts/brainstorm_handoff.py`.
  WHY: Any commenter starts a job holding `GH_PAT`, the OIDC token and `contents: write`.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:375-405 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `BRAINSTORM` role entry (engine claude, claude-fable-5-2) breaks tests/test_claude_engine.py (lines 74, 77, 84-93, 114-118), and that test file is not listed in Files & Modules. minimax_minimax-m3 also cites parallel assertions in other test files.
  WHY: Phase 1 fails CI and contradicts its "existing engine tests unchanged" criterion. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it BLOCKER, the others MAJOR, and the highest is kept.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:236-246 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `classify()` in scripts/claude_engine.py has no model-unavailable outcome, so the one-time model fallback has no signal.
  WHY: The fallback never fires or fires on every crash.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:64-102 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

  WHY: A consumer setting 5-8 exceeds the approved maximum and raises cost.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:148-316 | severity=major | confidence=4

  WHY: Goal 9 and the ledger outcome fields have no data source within the API-call budget.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:105-306 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The plan PR is opened ready and may auto-merge before the owner acts, while approve needs it open and reject closes it.
  WHY: A merged plan makes approve fail and leaves a rejected plan on the default branch.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:177-208 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A deferral "to the next day" is not retried, because weekly topics are due only on their weekday and no state is persisted before exit.
  WHY: A one-day deferral becomes a one-week deferral.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:296-306 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The non-idempotent orchestrator dispatch precedes the label swap, and the `command` job has no concurrency group.
  WHY: Two near-simultaneous `/brainstorm-approve` comments dispatch the orchestrator twice.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:426-436 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate's due-topic list can go stale before a session job starts, and there is no recheck before the session issue is created.
  WHY: A schedule run and a dispatch run can create duplicate session issues for one topic.
- docs/plans/brainstorm-debate-workflow-plan.md:88-92,347-352,426-436 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The daily wrapper runs a gate job on every full-profile consumer, including those with `BRAINSTORM_ENABLED` off. The plan has no trigger or job `if:` filter and no before/after job-count justification.
  WHY: Each opted-out consumer burns a runner job daily, which the runner-concurrency rule treats as a review blocker.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:41 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The plan cites line 32 as the clarify skip list, but line 32 is a comment and the skip list is the `if:` at line 41.
  WHY: The implement agent is pointed at the wrong site.
- scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh:(no diff site) | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The lint and static-checks runs stop with `outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed` because the branch base is behind main.
